review_summary.A: D0-D3 plus D2 are sufficient to justify one prospective model-scale step0 checkpoint qualification. They do not prove that page cache caused the B2 OOM, and that causal overclaim remains forbidden.
review_summary.B: The 128MiB D2 synthetic batching is acceptable for mechanism qualification because it exercised the same bounded-write completion/reclamation lifecycle. The model qualification must preserve the already-frozen <=8GB D2H bound rather than retune it.
review_summary.C: Keep host69, MemoryMax=52GiB, swap0, <=8GB D2H, unchanged Orbax/TensorStore/OCDBT semantics, and all scientific variables frozen so the operational contrast to B2 is the post-write reclamation mechanism only.
review_summary.S: Fresh host69 step0 save only. PASS requires frozen limits, no OOM/swap/tmp/prohibited activity, terminal PASS, cgroup memory.stat recording, and at least one eligible OCDBT blob completing fsync then POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED.
review_summary.V1: Preserve the stronger prior direct CPU per-leaf TensorStore path/shape/dtype/nbytes/SHA256 verification against S fingerprints.
review_summary.V2: After V1 PASS, fresh standard Orbax restore of the same immutable artifact with aggregate validation and state.step=0.
review_summary.stop_rule: Any S/V1/V2 failure closes B3. No retry or resource/batch/cache-advice ladder without a new independent review.
